From: Holly Reed <holly.reed@clearlinepayments.com>

Cc: ops@clearlinepayments.com
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clearline bank setup + remit string for Redwood

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking the next steps with Clearline. To get your account enabled for ACH and wire, please complete the attached vendor bank setup form and return it with a W-9 and either a voided check or bank letter. I attached the PDF forms to this message (clearline_bank_setup_form.pdf, clearline_w9.pdf).

A few quick notes that help our payout system match invoices to POs:
- Preferred remit format: "Clearline Payments | Redwood PO ####" (we can accept PO in either PO# or INV-PO format; confirm which you prefer).
- ACH timestamps: once bank details are verified we push ACHs on our weekly Tuesday run; wires can be same-day after verification for domestic banks.

When you reply, please indicate whether Redwood wants micro-deposits for verification or if you prefer sending a signed bank letter via DocuSign (link below). If you prefer DocuSign we can send the powerform.

DocuSign (optional): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-123-clearline-bank

If you want, include the Redwood PO mapping example on the completed form and I will confirm the exact remittance string we will include on payments.

Best,
Holly Reed
VP, Vendor Operations
Clearline Payments
--
Attachments: clearline_bank_setup_form.pdf (application/pdf), clearline_w9.pdf (application/pdf)

Mina — received, thanks for the completed form and the voided check. Confirming a few items: 

- We will initiate micro-deposits to the account on Friday 2027-08-06; deposits typically post within 1–3 business days depending on the receiving bank. Expect two small amounts (under $0.50) that you'll need to confirm back to us.
- Once you confirm the micro-deposit amounts we will mark the account as ACH-enabled. The next Tuesday ACH run after enablement will include Redwood payments (if an invoice cutoff is met).
- For remittance mapping, our system can accept the string exactly as you prefer. We recommend using: "Redwood Inference | PO: PO-2027-0894" — that format reduces ambiguity on our remittance parser. If you need it tweaked to "Redwood PO" we can do that, just confirm.

DocuSign option: if the micro-deposit flow is slower for you we can also send a bank-letter template via DocuSign for immediate verification.

I'll send a brief confirmation email once the micro-deposits are sent and follow up again when the account is fully active.

Best,
Holly
--
